lineDiffs.before: ◈ THE TRIBUTE — Avery and DeAndre walk out of Haven in the table's service, two fighters the galaxy asked for by name. The village is smaller tonight. The seat is open.
lineDiffs.after: ◈ THE TRIBUTE — Avery and DeAndre walk out of Haven in the table's service, two fighters the galaxy asked for by name. The village is smaller tonight. The deed is done — the seat still waits on the deeds.

lineDiffs.before: ◈ THE TABLE — between now and the seat, the world holds its breath. Nothing out there can take this from you.
lineDiffs.after: ◈ THE TABLE — between now and the seat, the world holds its breath. The wild can still take your food — but it cannot take your people.
